cypher.query:
MATCH (g:Gene {id: "ENSG00000001626"})-[gt:HAS_TRANSCRIPT]-(t:Transcript)
WITH g, gt, t ORDER BY t.id LIMIT 1
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[r]-(m)
WHERE m:Exon OR m:CDS_segments OR m:UTR_segments OR m:TSS_segment
WITH g, gt, t,
     collect(DISTINCT m)[0..8] AS children,
     collect(DISTINCT r)[0..8] AS child_edges
RETURN [g, t] + children AS nodes,
       [gt] + child_edges AS edges
